recipe.visualDefinition: A split-frame composition featuring a warm-toned, medium-close-up portrait of a man on the left, contrasted with a high-contrast, blue-tinted extreme close-up of his eyes on the right, separated by a vertical band of text.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones vs. cool blue highlights
Full face vs. extreme eye detail
Vertical text acting as a structural divider
Soft focus background vs. sharp foreground features
coreInvariants: Vertical orientation of all text elements
Direct eye contact in both frames

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject occupies the left two-thirds in a standard portrait crop; secondary subject (eyes) occupies the right third in an extreme zoom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes in the left-hand portrait, which are positioned at the upper-left intersection of thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the left face, moves right to the vertical text, then follows the text down to the blue-tinted eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the subject's hair and clothing provide dark negative space that frames the facial features.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm amber and brown skin tones (Left)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pure white for text and shirt collar
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white shirt/text and the dark background; saturated blue vs. naturalistic skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to amber, blue, black, and white

letterConstructionRules: 90-degree clockwise rotation for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'b' and 'f' in the primary title have elongated, fluid curves

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on the boundary between the two portraits
aligned parallel to the primary title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the name paired with a minimalist geometric sans for the descriptive text.

candidateDirections.reason: High contrast and elegant serifs match the primary title's sophisticated feel.
Geometric sans-serifs provide the clean, modern look for the spaced-out subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a split-screen image. The left side is a warm-toned studio portrait of a man with dark hair in a black suit and white shirt. The right side is a vertical sliver showing an extreme close-up of the same man's eyes, tinted in a deep, high-contrast cyan-blue. The two sections should be separated by a dark vertical shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical text along the dividing line. The main title should be a bold, high-contrast serif in lowercase, rotated 90 degrees clockwise. To its right, add a subtitle in a small, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif, also rotated 90 degrees clockwise. All text must be white.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear color temperature difference between the left and right sides?
Are the eyes in the blue section sharp and high-contrast?
Is the primary title in a serif font and the subtitle in a sans-serif?

adjustableVariables: Width of the vertical text divider
Degree of letter spacing in the subtitle
mustRedesign: Mixing warm and cool tones within the same frame (keep them split)

mustAchieve: Distinct color separation between the two panels
Soft, professional studio lighting on the main portrait
avoid: Low-contrast text that blends into the subject
Pixelated or blurry eye details in the blue section

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is strictly lowercase as per the 90s aesthetic.
Ensure the blue tint is vibrant and not just a desaturated grey.
Verify the vertical alignment of the two text blocks.
Confirm the subject's gaze is directed at the viewer in both frames.
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-frame portraiture + Vertical rotated typography + Bi-chromatic color contrast (Warm/Cool).
